requirements.text: The system must improve the student experience by making schedule management and coursework tracking easier.
The system must ensure stability and not disrupt the current setup.
Students should be able to customize their timetable view with color-coding, hide canceled classes, and add their own study blocks.
Customization of the timetable should not change how students access their timetable.
Students should receive automated notifications for new grades, assignment deadlines, and exam dates.
Students should have the flexibility to choose how they receive notifications (email, SMS, or in-app).
Students should be able to submit feedback on their modules after the teaching period ends, focusing on content quality and delivery.
The feedback process should be simple and encourage honest responses from students.
